allow: PowerShell($candidates = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\nodejs\\node.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\nodejs\\node.exe", "$env:APPDATA\\nvm", "$env:ProgramFiles\\nodejs"\); foreach \($c in $candidates\) { if \(Test-Path $c\) { Write-Output "FOUND: $c" } }; Get-Command bun, deno, yarn, pnpm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Source)

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\nodejs", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\nodejs", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Microsoft\\WinGet\\Packages"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path "$p\\node.exe"\) { Write-Output "node at: $p" } }; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Microsoft\\WinGet\\Packages" -Filter "node.exe" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName)
